units.source_text: 只要在银座街上走，肯定会有两三个人向我打听这狗是什么品种。

en.t: If I merely walk along Ginza Street, two or three people are sure to ask me what breed this dog is.

units.source_text: 就在马路的正中，一个西洋人求我将这狗卖给他，弄得我好生为难。”

en.t: Right in the middle of the road, a Westerner begged me to sell him this dog, which put me in a terrible spot.”
